claim_ceiling: ADR-0344 Proposed/advisory manifest declaration only; no runtime instrumentation (including provider dispatch instrumentation), measured emissions, live billing, OpenCost/FOCUS export, generated JSON, or production FinOps readiness claim.

workload_signal_source.source_ref: model-routing, provider dispatch, guardrail refusal, evaluation, retrieval, attribution, and audit-tap capability envelopes

power_model.derivation_note: Values emphasize Intelligence's outbound provider calls, guardrail/eval/retrieval fanout, 32 outbound HTTP baseline, and Tier-1 tenant-data substrate posture; they are bespoke fixture coefficients, not copied ADR examples.

price_model.non_claim: Fixture records provider-SKU binding only; it does not call model providers, mutate invoices, or allocate tenant charges.

review_notes.no_carbon_deferral: Tier 1 AI dispatch, guardrail, and provider-credential paths are ineligible for carbon deferral under ADR-0344 B2/D-9.
review_notes.security_tenant_data_plane: Provider credential references, sensitive prompts, minor/high-risk audiences, and guardrail/audit outcomes require Tier-1 isolation.
review_notes.audit_chain: Audit-tap events and refusal/provider-dispatch events are the future source of five-field ADR-0344 attribution.

failure_cases: provider dispatch audit row missing provider/region/cost/co2/watt_hours
template-stamped ADR D-2.2 coefficients appear in the manifest
provider price binding is stale or unpinned

recalibration.evidence_floor: capability-level resource samples split by provider dispatch, guardrail, eval, retrieval, and attribution paths
